svg.title: Повороты грудного отдела лёжа — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Side-lying thoracic open-book rotation, view from above at 35 degrees to show arm opening and floor contacts. START athlete lying on left side, hips and knees bent and stacked, both arms extended together at shoulder height in front. FINISH upper right arm opens in a broad arc behind with chest rotating toward ceiling, left arm remains out in front, knees remain bent and in contact, pelvis stable. No weights. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
